evidence.detail: rs/B owns one sentinel rs/a NodeSub plus one current-iteration NodeSub. Its constructor self-links the sentinel through NodeSub's secondary previous/next pointers.

Its insertion method unlinks an already-linked NodeSub then splices it at the sentinel head; its removal method takes the tail NodeSub, unlinks it and returns it; two traversal methods walk the same secondary-link chain; d() counts nodes without mutation.
R24 OnDemandFetcher owns this exact queue and stores rs/cache/c OnDemandData instances in it; OnDemandData extends R25 NodeSub, fixing the queue element hierarchy independently of historical naming.
Classic 317/RSPS source preserves class Queue with the same sentinel NodeSub/Cacheable structure and the same insertHead, popTail, reverseGetFirst, reverseGetNext and getNodeCount contract.

proposals.note: Queue is strongly corroborated by exact-v308 NodeSub queue behavior and classic 317 lineage. Exact v308 remains the semantic authority.
